ios.desc:
stop wasting time figuring out whether someone is right for you. nectar matches you based on who you are, what you want, and how compatible you actually are.

discover your loveprint

learn how you approach dating and relationships.

decide what you want

casual, intentional or committed.

see who actually fits

Get compatibility insights that help you understand your matches before investing your time.

Start with two quick quizzes: relationship readiness (casual, intentional, committed) and loveprint (your unique dating style, out of 16). Together they cut through the noise, so you only match with people who fit what you’re actually looking for. 

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

nectar is for anyone tired of wasting time. Whether you’re here for fun, something serious, or to meet meaningful people who match your energy. Every match comes with a compatibility report: your score, your strengths, your red flags. You’ll know if it’s worth the effort before you waste your time. Think of it as receipts before you even send that first message.

Built by jubilee media, the team behind viral shows about love and connection, nectar takes those conversations off screen and into your dating life.

Ready to take things offline? If you both press the let’s meet button, it’s a green light. No more awkward “sooo what are we doing?” needed. nectar also works beyond the app. met someone irl? Search their username and see if your compatibility holds up. 

Download nectar dating by Jubilee and find your loveprint today.

quotes.text:
Non-profit is not the same as not monetized. Somehow you will have to pay for the infrastructure running the app. If it's ads, you likely wouldn't have a large enough audience to get enough impressions. If it's subscriptions, how is that any different from other paid dating apps? I'm actually working on a dating app at the moment and it is currently not monetized:

  iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nectar-dating-by-jubilee/id6476018063
  Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jubilee.nectarmobile
